verdict.rationale: Coinbase publishes an official CDP SDK on GitHub (coinbase/cdp-sdk) with client libraries for EVM and Solana wallets. The docs reference that SDK for x402 pay and charge flows and for payments workflows such as USDC acceptance and treasury payouts. Missing for 10: documentation of supported languages and SDK reference depth for the custodial payments APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
